processor-info.script: String cmd = input.getText("cmd"); executeSQL(cmd, connection, input, output);

sql.query: select a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, a.title, a.play_time, a.summary, a.file_path, a.html_path, b.lecture_div from tb_cyber_class a, tb_cyber_lecture b where a.lecture_seq_no = ? and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no

SELECT top $rnum user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, case status when '00' then '수강전' when '01' then '수강중' when '02' then '평가중' when '03' then '완료' when '09' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , certication_file_path, title, dbo.formatDateTime(start_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(end_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') end_dt, tot_cnt, lecture_div FROM ( select a.user_lecture_seq_no, a.lecture_seq_no, a.status, a.certication_file_path, c.title, d.start_dt, d.end_dt, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.user_lecture_seq_no desc) rnum, COUNT(a.user_lecture_seq_no) over() tot_cnt, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( select user_lecture_seq_no , min( t.study_start_dt) start_dt , max( t.study_end_dt ) end_dt from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS t where status <> '9' group by user_lecture_seq_no) d ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = d.user_lecture_seq_no WHERE a.user_seq_no = ? AND a.status <> '99' $addWhere )a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, status, status_nm, certication_file_path, title, start_dt, end_dt, tot_cnt, lecture_div

sql.query: select a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, b.title, b.play_time, b.summary, b.file_path, b.html_path, ISNULL(a.status,'') status, case ISNULL(a.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '수강중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , a.estimate_pass_yn, case ISNULL(a.estimate_pass_yn,'N') when 'Y' then '완료' else case ISNULL(a.status,'0') when '0' then '평가전' when '1' then '평가전' when '2' then '평가중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END END AS estimate_nm , a.user_class_seq_no, a.user_lecture_seq_no, ISNULL(a.estimate_cnt , 0 ) estimate_cnt, b.teacher, b.history_path, b.edu_path, b.photo_path, c.lecture_div from tb_cyber_user_class a,tb_cyber_class b, tb_cyber_lecture c where a.class_no = b.class_no and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? order by b.class_no

mapping.getProperty: lecture_seq_no,class_no,title,play_time,summary,file_path,html_path,status,status_nm, estimate_pass_yn,estimate_nm, user_class_seq_no, user_lecture_seq_no, estimate_cnt, teacher, history_path, edu_path, photo_path, lecture_div

sql.query: select a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, b.title, b.play_time, b.summary, b.file_path, b.html_path, ISNULL(a.status,'') status, case ISNULL(a.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '수강중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , ISNULL(a.estimate_pass_yn,'N') estimate_pass_yn, case ISNULL(a.estimate_pass_yn,'N') when 'Y' then '완료' else case ISNULL(a.status,'0') when '0' then '평가전' when '1' then '평가전' when '2' then '평가중' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END END AS estimate_nm , a.user_class_seq_no, a.user_lecture_seq_no, ISNULL(a.estimate_cnt , 0 ) estimate_cnt, b.teacher, b.history_path, b.edu_path, b.photo_path, c.lecture_div from tb_cyber_user_class a,tb_cyber_class b, tb_cyber_lecture c where a.class_no = b.class_no and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND a.status <> '9' order by b.class_no

mapping.getProperty: lecture_seq_no,class_no,title,play_time,summary,file_path,html_path,status,status_nm, estimate_pass_yn,estimate_nm, user_class_seq_no, user_lecture_seq_no, estimate_cnt, teacher, history_path, edu_path, photo_path, lecture_div

sql.query: select a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, a.title, a.play_time, a.summary, a.file_path, a.html_path, ISNULL(b.status,'') status, case ISNULL(b.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '완료' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , b.estimate_pass_yn, case ISNULL(b.estimate_pass_yn,'N') when 'Y' then '완료' else '평가전' END AS estimate_nm , b.user_class_seq_no, b.user_lecture_seq_no, a.photo_path, c.lecture_div from tb_cyber_class a ,tb_cyber_user_class b,tb_cyber_lecture c where a.class_no = b.class_no and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and b.user_lecture_seq_no = ? order by b.class_no

select a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, a.title, a.play_time, a.summary, a.file_path, a.html_path, ISNULL(b.status,'') status, case ISNULL(b.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '완료' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , b.estimate_pass_yn, case ISNULL(b.estimate_pass_yn,'N') when 'Y' then '완료' else '평가전' END AS estimate_nm , b.user_class_seq_no, b.user_lecture_seq_no, a.photo_path, c.lecture_div from tb_cyber_class a left outer join tb_cyber_user_class b on a.class_no = b.class_no left outer join tb_cyber_lecture c on a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no where a.lecture_seq_no = ? and a.class_no = ?
select top 1 user_class_seq_no, estimate_cnt from tb_cyber_user_class a where a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? and ISNULL(a.estimate_pass_yn, 'N' ) != 'Y' and a.status <> '9' order by class_no

select a.lecture_seq_no, c.title, a.class_no, a.title cls_title, a.play_time, a.summary, a.file_path, a.html_path, ISNULL(b.status,'') status, case ISNULL(b.status,'0') when '0' then '수강전' when '1' then '수강중' when '2' then '완료' when '3' then '완료' when '4' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm , b.estimate_pass_yn, case ISNULL(b.estimate_pass_yn,'N') when 'Y' then '완료' else '평가전' END AS estimate_nm , b.user_class_seq_no, b.user_lecture_seq_no, ISNULL(b.estimate_point,0) estimate_point, case b.estimate_cnt when null then 0 when 0 then 5 else estimate_cnt end as estimate_cnt, b.estimate_cha, d.status lecture_status, a.photo_path, c.lecture_div from tb_cyber_class a ,tb_cyber_user_class b, tb_cyber_lecture c, tb_cyber_user_lecture d where a.class_no = b.class_no and a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no and b.USER_LECTURE_SEQ_NO = d.USER_LECTURE_SEQ_NO and b.user_class_seq_no = ?

mapping.getProperty: lecture_seq_no, title, class_no, cls_title, play_time, summary, file_path, html_path, status, status_nm , estimate_pass_yn, estimate_nm , user_class_seq_no, user_lecture_seq_no, estimate_point, estimate_cnt, estimate_cha, lecture_status, photo_path, lecture_div
